buildspecOverride:
version: 0.2
env:
  shell: bash
phases:
  pre_build:
    on-failure: ABORT
    commands:
      - |
        set -euo pipefail
        test "$CODEBUILD_RESOLVED_SOURCE_VERSION" = "192cca3a1386eb2ceb370e01f6041e338709ab24"
        test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "192cca3a1386eb2ceb370e01f6041e338709ab24"
        test "$(uname -m)" = aarch64
        test "$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text)" = 967807252336
        python3 scripts/validate-meri-build-isolation.py
        aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 967807252336.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
        docker pull public.ecr.aws/docker/library/node@sha256:b20fe038d9592822dd534600a1ddf467e985178aa3fed60ec441a056c2cc45bd
        docker tag public.ecr.aws/docker/library/node@sha256:b20fe038d9592822dd534600a1ddf467e985178aa3fed60ec441a056c2cc45bd node:22.23.3-bookworm-slim
  build:
    on-failure: ABORT
    commands:
      - |
        set -euo pipefail
        docker build --platform linux/arm64 --build-arg NODE_VERSION=22.23.3  --label org.opencontainers.image.revision=192cca3a1386eb2ceb370e01f6041e338709ab24 -f apps/engagement-api/Dockerfile -t 967807252336.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/capiro/dev/engagement-api:192cca3a1386eb2ceb370e01f6041e338709ab24 .
        test "$(docker image inspect 967807252336.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/capiro/dev/engagement-api:192cca3a1386eb2ceb370e01f6041e338709ab24 --format '{{.Architecture}}')" = arm64
  post_build:
    on-failure: ABORT
    commands:
      - |
        set -euo pipefail
        docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sh 967807252336.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/capiro/dev/engagement-api:192cca3a1386eb2ceb370e01f6041e338709ab24 -c 'grep -q debriefEncrypted ./dist/engagement/krisp/krisp-notetaker.service.js'
        docker push 967807252336.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/capiro/dev/engagement-api:192cca3a1386eb2ceb370e01f6041e338709ab24
        aws ecr describe-images --region us-east-1 --repository-name capiro/dev/engagement-api --image-ids imageTag=192cca3a1386eb2ceb370e01f6041e338709ab24 --query 'imageDetails[0].imageDigest' --output text
